title: KnitNet: Learning to Search at Inference Time for Exact RNA Inverse Design
abstract: arXiv:2611.33812v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: RNA inverse design seeks nucleotide sequences that fold into specified target structures. Existing methods rely on learned generators that can miss exact structural matches, especially beyond their training distributions, or on costly search over a vast, multimodal sequence space. Search is further complicated by globally coupled nucleotide interactions, as correcting one pairing error can create new errors beyond a fixed repair scope. To address this, we introduce KnitNet, an inference-time scaling framework that learns from verifier feedback to refine sequences for exact fold-back matching. Starting from candidates generated for a target secondary structure, KnitNet uses mismatched folds to infer nucleotide dependencies and adapt its joint repair strategy, while an online surrogate learns to predict which edits are promising. translated_title: KnitNet：在推理时学习搜索以实现精确的RNA逆向设计
translated_abstract: RNA逆向设计旨在寻找能够折叠成指定目标结构的核苷酸序列。现有方法依赖于学习到的生成器，但这些生成器可能无法找到精确的结构匹配，尤其是在超出其训练分布的情况下；或者需要在庞大且多模态的序列空间上进行代价高昂的搜索。由于核苷酸之间存在全局耦合的相互作用，搜索变得更加复杂——修正一个配对错误可能会在固定修复范围之外引发新的错误。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了KnitNet，这是一个推理时扩展（inference-time scaling）框架，它从验证器的反馈中学习来精炼序列，以实现精确的折叠回匹配。从为目标二级结构生成的候选序列出发，KnitNet利用折叠不匹配的结果来推断核苷酸之间的依赖关系，并自适应地调整其联合修复策略，同时一个在线代理模型学习预测哪些编辑操作是有希望的。这使得搜索过程逐渐变得更加信息化且计算高效。至关重要的是，KnitNet能够跨RNA...（原文摘要此处截断）
tldr: KnitNet是一个推理时扩展框架，通过从验证器反馈中学习核苷酸间的全局依赖关系并自适应调整联合修复策略，实现了RNA逆向设计中精确结构匹配的高效搜索。
en_tdlr: KnitNet is an inference-time scaling framework that learns nucleotide dependencies from verifier feedback and adaptively refines joint repair strategies, enabling efficient search for exact structural matches in RNA inverse design.
